title: storage-emissions: transparent framework for assessing the emission impact of battery storage dispatch
description: Code accompanying "From marginal emission factors to storage dispatch: a transparent framework for assessing the emission impact of battery operation in electricity markets" (Diependaal, Boonman & Chiesa, 2026). Reconstructs a price-consistent, hourly marginal emission intensity (MEI) signal from public day-ahead prices, fuel prices, and power plant characteristics, and couples it to battery dispatch under five strategies (greedy benchmark, profit-maximising, emission-minimising, and two lexicographic variants) to quantify the cashflow-emission trade-off. Case study: 1 MW / 2 MWh battery in the Dutch bidding zone, 2018-2025.
